content:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT: unusual auth/embedding probe detected from multiple IPs in a single ASN targeting /v1/login and /v1/embeddings. Auto-rate-limit triggered for the subnet; paging oncall.
ryan-oncall: ack, looking now. pulling logs for 23.45.67.0/24 entries.
maya-eng: initial signal looks like HEAD + small payloads, rotating API keys, ~7.5k rps to embeddings endpoint from SEA edge.
uma-sre: seeing 502 spikes and kv-cache thrash on embedding workers, likely overloaded by high fanout.
ops-liz: customers flagged elevated error rates for a few APAC tenants — investigating impact lists.
ryan-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) apply geo rate-shaping for SEA ASN for auth+embed routes, 2) enable strict per-token quota slices for anonymous keys, 3) add WAF acl for obvious probe patterns. executing step 1 now.
maya-eng: adding suggestion: disable anonymous embeddings POST for 20m while we triage. will prepare config.
ryan-oncall: Step 1 done — rate-shaped subnet 23.45.67.0/24 to 5rps per-IP, observed inbound drop ~70%.
uma-sre: preparing WAF rule. proposed snippet:
```
// block obvious probe pattern
if (ip in 23.45.67.0/24 && path in ['/v1/login','/v1/embeddings'] && method in ['HEAD','POST'] && user_agent =~ /libcurl|python-requests/) {
  action: block_challenge('captcha')
}
```
ops-liz: pushed temporary quota changes to anonymous keys — per-key slice 1000 req/day, notify infra.
ryan-oncall: disabling anonymous embeddings POST (will still allow auth'd requests). rolling now.
maya-eng: logs show successful knockdown on embedding traffic, auth probe rps still trickling but within limits.
ops-liz: customer impact: 5 smaller APAC tenants saw 429s during window, major customers unaffected. Notifying affected customers via status page draft.
pagerduty-bot: Pager duty alert acknowledged by ryan-oncall at 2842001258. Next oncall: uma-sre in 30m for scheduled handoff.
uma-sre: taking over monitoring. recommended follow-ups: collect sample payloads for ML fingerprinting, add ASN-based denylist if this recurs, consider rolling challenge for low-trust routes.
ryan-oncall: handoff complete — leaving runbook steps in incident doc, will follow-up with postmortem if we need lasting rules.
ops-liz: status page updated: "Partial service degradation for some APAC embedding requests; mitigations applied."
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigation active, monitoring. No further pages unless error rate > 5% or latency > 2s for 10m.
